Type: coffee table with drawers
Use: storage and serving in front of a sofa; living room
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: painted wood, satin nickel knobs
Colors: deep raspberry red, silver
Shape: rectangular, two front drawers with round knobs, geometric square fretwork cutouts on the sides, lower shelf, straight square legs, medium visual weight

Goes with: cream, white or navy, patterned textiles, light wood; eclectic or traditional living rooms
